questions.question: Rely on the global middleware, or introduce per-route auth?
questions.rationale: In backend, the requirements assume: Authentication can be applied per route. The checkout instead has: Authentication is applied once, globally, in server/config/express.js. Evidence: server/config/express.js.
questions.suggested_answer: Follow what backend already does: Authentication is applied once, globally, in server/config/express.js.
questions.suggestion_source: Suggested from repository analysis of backend (server/config/express.js)
